components.name: Solar Cells (Monocrystalline Silicon)
components.reasoning: These cells are the core photovoltaic element that converts sunlight into electricity, universally present in every module and typically procured as a wafer or cell assembly prior to module fabrication.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: The front protective glass layer is essential to shield cells from weather, mechanical damage, and UV exposure; it is a standardized, separately manufactured component across the industry.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: Frames provide structural integrity and mounting interfaces; aluminum framed modules are industry-standard, though frameless designs exist, the frame is nearly always procured separately.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA)
components.reasoning: Ethylene-vinyl acetate (EVA) sheets encapsulate cells to provide mechanical support and environmental protection; this is a key processed polymer sheet procured apart from other materials.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: The backsheet is a polymer sheet providing electrical insulation and moisture barrier at the rear of the module; it is procured as a separate component and essential for module durability.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: Houses electrical connections and bypass diodes, critical for safe module operation; it is a packaged electrical subassembly bought separately from module lamination components.
